summary: Two stops triggered: AVGO's post-earnings intraday recovery to $479 failed to hold into the June 4 close ($418.91, -12.6% from reference); NOC edged below its $535 stop at $534.60 as Iran ceasefire MOU 'mostly agreed' compresses the defense geopolitical premium. Three new ideas added: Long XLF (NFP rate-relief + Iran de-escalation financials play, 2–4 weeks), Long PLTR re-entry at demand zone ($138–143, SpaceX federal data infrastructure catalyst, 4–8 weeks), and Short AVGO (AI capex plateau Phase 2 repricing, low conviction, 3–6 weeks). Pre-NFP regime HOLD — Brent Day-3 below $97, 30Y approaching third sub-5.00% close, VIX ~17; May NFP at 8:30 AM ET is the session's decisive binary for HOLD confirmation.

closed_today.note: AVGO's same-session intraday recovery from -13% pre-market ($413) to $479.23 — the catalyst for the June 4 long entry — failed to hold into the close. June 4 close at $418.91 triggered the $435 daily-close stop. The recovery was a false floor; institutional sellers reloaded into the intraday bid. Guidance-plateau repricing continues.

NOC closed at $534.60 on June 4 — one tick below the $535 daily-close stop. Iran ceasefire MOU 'mostly agreed' is deflating the geopolitical war premium in defense names. B-21 and GBSD fundamental thesis intact; exit is a mechanical rule-following, not a fundamental call.
